title: cajanus scarabaeoides
intro: Cajanus scarabaeoides, commonly known as the Indian cluster bean or Adzuki bean, is a type of legume native to tropical regions of Asia and Australia. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Cajanus scarabaeoides include its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may contribute to its use in treating conditions such as diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
